options.name: consolecli_enabled
options.description: Enable/Disable state of the console-based controlled CLI (TTY1).

options.name: dcui_enabled
options.description: Enable/Disable state of Direct Console User Interface (DCUI TTY2).

options.name: dns_append
options.description: If V(true) items from O(dns_domains) and O(dns_servers) will be added to already configured DNS domains/servers. If V(false) domains/servers will be overridden.

options.name: dns_domains
options.description: List of DNS domains.

options.name: dns_hostname
options.description: DNS hostname.

options.name: dns_mode
options.description: Set the DNS mode.

options.name: dns_servers
options.description: List of DNS servers.

options.name: firewall_rules
options.description: Set the ordered list of firewall rules to allow or deny traffic from one or more incoming IP addresses. Within the list of traffic rules, rules are processed in order of appearance, from top to bottom.

options.name: firewall_rules_append
options.description: If false the rules overwrites the existing firewall rules and creates a new rule list. If true we append the rules to existing rules.

options.name: global_fips
options.description: Enable/Disable Global FIPS mode for the appliance. Caution: Changing the value of this setting will reboot the Appliance.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: noproxy
options.description: List of hosts that should be ignored by proxy configuration.

options.name: ntp_servers
options.description: List of NTP servers. This method updates old NTP servers from configuration and sets the input NTP servers in the configuration. If NTP based time synchronization is used internally, the NTP daemon will be restarted to reload given NTP configuration. In case NTP based time synchronization is not used, this method only replaces servers in the NTP configuration.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy
options.description: A list of proxy configurations.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_protocol
options.description: The proxy connection protocol to use. This option is used if the correct proxy protocol cannot be automatically determined.

options.name: resize_storage
options.description: Resize all partitions to 100 percent of disk size.

options.name: shell_enabled
options.description: Enable/Disable state of BASH, that is, access to BASH from within the controlled CLI.

options.name: shell_timeout
options.description: The timeout (in seconds) specifies how long you enable the Shell access. The maximum timeout is 86400 seconds(1 day). This parameter is mandatory in case O(shell_enabled=true).

options.name: ssh_enabled
options.description: Enable/Disable state of the SSH-based controlled CLI.

options.name: timesync_mode
options.description: Set time synchronization mode.

options.name: timezone
options.description: Set time zone.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
